digest.component_or_area: S3 store recovery and push reconciliation
propositions: When two or more .bundle objects exist for the same ref in S3, git ls-remote returns the ref at multiple SHAs and fresh clones fail with 'multiple updates for ref not allowed', making the store unclonable.

The git-remote-s3 helper rejects push operations with 'multiple bundles exists on server' when bundles > 1, before any bundle is written, and upstream's interactive Doctor.fix_multiple_bundles discards the non-chosen head, losing unique events from the append-only event log.

The recovery must fold N divergent bundle heads losslessly via iterated 2-parent merges (following sync._union_merge semantics), write the merged tip as a new bundle before deleting originals, and maintain crash safety: at every point >= 1 bundle carries the full merged history.
Detection in push_tickets_branch must identify the multi-bundle failure signature and auto-invoke heal_multi_bundle exactly once (healed_once guard) without infinite retry loops.

The doctor must serialize cross-clone repairs via the helper's acquire_lock/release_lock (S3 conditional-put with TTL), re-enumerate under lock to guard against TOCTOU, and release the lock after all S3 operations, never consuming a direct S3 SDK dependency in core rebar (boto3 is transitive under [s3]).
On a genuine non-derived-file conflict the heal must abort without deleting any remote bundle, release the lock, and surface rebar fsck-recover rather than silently dropping a parent.
